title: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德：通胀增长风险更趋平衡人工智能加速变革需新工具
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's the speed at which things change.
And that is clearly accelerated by AI.
segments.zh: 而人工智能显然加速了这一进程。

segments.en: And I think in that context, we have to be open to new measurements, new ways of thinking, new tools that help us and assist in making the right decisions.
segments.zh: 因此，我们必须对新测量方法、新思维和新工具持开放态度，以帮助我们做出正确决策。

segments.en: So I think in that context, the use of scenarios, for instance, that we have now really nailed down with milder, severe
segments.zh: 例如，我们现在已经确定了温和、严重和不利的情景，

segments.en: and adverse scenario to make sure that our decisions are solid and robust across scenarios.
segments.zh: 以确保我们的决策在各种情景下都稳健可靠。

segments.en: The fact that we're incorporating risk into our assessment of inflation, and I think risks, by the way, that we have to the upside on inflation
segments.zh: 我们将风险纳入通胀评估，通胀上行风险

segments.en: and to the downside of growth, are probably more broadly balanced.
segments.zh: 和增长下行风险可能更加平衡。

segments.en: And there were a few weeks ago as a result of what we're seeing, which happens at speed.
segments.zh: 几周前，由于快速变化的情况，这种平衡发生了变化。

segments.en: If you look at how fast the price of oil, spot price, granted, has moved down, you know, $72 a barrel.
segments.zh: 看看原油现货价格下跌的速度，已降至每桶72美元。

segments.en: Now, when it was $120 back in March, these are changes that are just so accelerated that we have to be prepared
segments.zh: 而三月份时还是120美元，这些变化如此之快，我们必须做好准备。

segments.en: to measure differently and more accurately using AI, for instance.
segments.zh: 例如，利用人工智能进行更精准的差异化衡量。
